look: The HUD is a close copy of the reference: pill top bar, green market card top right, care panel bottom right, centred prompt stack, Move and E corner buttons. It uses the kit models with correct vertex colour. The world reads differently. The meadow is saturated neon green where the reference is soft and pale. The camera sits high over the whole plot instead of close behind the gardener, so the prompt pills cover the gardener once the garden grows. A south fence crosses in front of the plot, where the reference has flowers. The soil is unshaded, flat in daylight and glowing tan at night.
summary: Faithful: every rule from R1 to R15 follows the brief's numbers and formulas in one deterministic integer simulation, the HUD closely copies the reference layout, and the proof reruns green in 4 s with fresh-process save and offline checks. Missing: the camera never follows the gardener (it frames the garden centre, so walking away leaves the screen), and the watering, harvest-flight and chime effects could not be confirmed in stills. Wrong or off: the meadow is far more saturated than the reference, the unshaded soil glows at night, a south fence and the high camera change the reference framing, and P1-P8 are proven only on the simulation object (no key or click input into the real game).
